N1.s: Tu as utilisé tes %lld cutlings gratuits. Continue dans Cutling pour le débloquer et ajouter celui-ci.
N1.back: You have used your %lld cutlings free. Continue in Cutling for it to-unlock and to-add this-one.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own sentence so the limit reads the same everywhere; le is Cutling and celui-ci is the cutling being saved, so the two jobs (unlock, then this item gets added) sit in one purpose clause. 99 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N2.s: Tu as utilisé tes %lld cutlings gratuits. Ouvre Cutling pour le débloquer et en ajouter plus.
N2.back: You have used your %lld cutlings free. Open Cutling for it to-unlock and of-them to-add more.
N2.why: Same opening as N1 and S3; ouvre because this reply cannot hand over to the app, and en ajouter plus repeats S28's en ajouter so Siri says it the same way. 90 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N3.why: Ajouté agrees with the unsaid cutling, and plus qu'un is how French counts down what is left (plus qu'une place); gratuit alone follows S1, S29 and K1. 26 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N4.why: Repeats S29's count word for word, so 5 sur 5 says the free ones are full without a warning word. 24 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N5.back: %1$lld of %2$lld free [ones]. Unlock, it you waits
N5.why: The same count as N4, then an imperative in tu to tap, as in K1; il t'attend says the item is kept and waiting, which pour l'ajouter could not fit in 40. 39 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N6.why: The infinitive button form, identical to S15 so the word is the same in the app and the Share sheet. 9 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N7.s: Tu as utilisé tes %lld cutlings gratuits. Débloque Cutling pour ajouter celui-ci.
N7.back: You have used your %lld cutlings free. Unlock Cutling for to-add this-one.
N7.why: S3's sentence again, then Débloque Cutling as in K1; celui-ci points at the cutling in the form just below. 78 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

N8.s: Ton cutling est mis de côté. Ouvre Cutling et débloque-le pour l’ajouter.
N8.back: Your cutling is put of side. Open Cutling and unlock-it for it to-add.
N8.why: Mettre de côté is what a shop says when it holds something for you, which is the reassurance here; the person opens Cutling themselves because the Share sheet could not. 73 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.
